facts.claim: 8442 changes product compiler inputs only in Cargo/example plumbing, config certificate parser visibility, Node workspace-bind RootCommand control, GrpcRootMeta RootCommand polling/wire adapter, RootManager Home revocation guards, and one native fixture test; tests/support/root_command_meta.rs is new test support.

facts.claim: src/node/rpc/meta.rs ordinary existing RootMeta RPC method bodies are not changed in the f03..8442 diff; the diff adds poll_root_command_batch and promotes/adapts RootCommandBatch parsing from test-only/private shape to production ownerfs-gated structs. Existing imports change only to include PollRootCommandBatchRequest.

Node starts RootCommand polling only when experimental_ownerfs_workspace_bind is true and startup had no workspace startup error; ordinary default-OFF path leaves workspace_bind_root_control None and does not spawn run_workspace_bind_root_commands.

RootManager phase/Meta-control guards are in common OwnerFs admission code and therefore are within default-OFF impact scope, but their new public effect is refusal after an exact active-Home revocation or invalid control session; wrong Home/session/generation/missing root returns false or leaves current active grant usable.

Core filesystem operation surfaces used by old standard suites are byte-identical between f03 and 8442 for OwnerFs dispatcher/files/catalog/remote, FUSE, locks, DFS, local-file Meta store, owner_roots Meta store, meta.proto and bind_mount.rs.

Current 8442 default-OFF package/installation/local-file Meta normal restart recovery is already PASS with 43 independent checks, OwnerFs and DFS 64MiB SHA/EOF recovery, two workspace switches OFF, R1/gRPC/local-file effective/generated config, 3 actual wait0 receipts and 6 PIDs gone; this is not full POSIX or performance.

RootCommand/RootManager targeted evidence exists on the 8442 compiler map: 59 scoped Rust tests passed according to README; result.json records 46 saved-data audit checks and 58 driver checks. The README breaks the 59 into 21 batch/control/store, 22 RootManager, 2 worker, 8 Meta contracts, 4 issuer, 2 certificate tests.

Historical standard evidence remains version-scoped: Owner e925 standards, DFS 0891 standards and local R1 DFS standards are preserved as bounded historical PASS, not relabeled as current 8442 full-standard PASS.

inferences.claim: The strongest current claim is: 8442 does not alter ordinary filesystem operation implementation files relative to f03, and its new RootCommand consumer is default-OFF gated. Therefore old standard evidence is not invalidated wholesale by code diff alone.

Because RootManager common admission code changed, a strict current-version standard label should not rely solely on old e925/0891 standard runs. The existing 22 RootManager tests plus current OFF install/recovery substantially reduce this risk but do not equal a current pjdfstest/LTP/FSx run.

GrpcRootMeta ordinary RPC behavior is unlikely to regress from this patch because no existing method body changed; the new parser/poller can only be reached by the workspace-bind RootCommand worker, which is ON-gated in Node.
